test_transpose: test the DataFrame.transpose method to verify rows become columns and columns become rows with correct values
test_transpose_td64_intervals: test DataFrame transpose with timedelta64 interval index containing NaN values
test_transpose_empty_preserves_datetimei: test DataFrame transpose preserves empty DatetimeIndex dtype and index equality
test_transpose_tzaware: test DataFrame transpose preserves timezone-aware datetime dtypes across single and multiple columns
test_transpose_mixed_tz: test DataFrame transpose with mixed timezone columns falls back to object dtype and round-trips correctly
